title: X canonical URL caused full LLM regeneration
reproduction: A source begins as /i/status/<id> and acquisition resolves it to /<author>/status/<id>.
impact: The same valid director manifest was regenerated, adding 22 LLM calls and avoidable cost.

title: Missing browser text aborted an otherwise valid render
reproduction: A source page changes DOM text after the director selected an exact evidence target.
impact: Capture failed instead of preserving the source page with an honest non-highlighted fallback.

title: GitHub placeholder description became a fake browser target
reproduction: The GitHub API returns the literal placeholder 'No repository description'.
impact: The recorder searched for text that was never visible on the repository page.

title: Launchd lock contention was recorded as a pipeline crash
reproduction: A scheduled launch overlaps a still-running manual or launchd pipeline.
impact: A healthy no-op collision polluted the bug audit as a crash.

title: Sensitive research review could be confused with publication approval
reproduction: A security-research video reaches the dashboard with only the editorial safety gate blocked.
impact: One click could ambiguously mean both safety review and publication authorization.

title: Model video title named the publisher but omitted the model
reproduction: A repair shortens a model hook by dropping GLM-5.3-Flash while retaining OrcaRouter.
impact: Viewers cannot identify which model the metrics describe.

title: Specialist metric was not explained for vibe coders
reproduction: The hook says refusal rate or rejection rate with a percentage but never defines the metric.
impact: A technically curious non-research audience sees numbers without understanding what they measure.

title: Long exact titles risked losing entities instead of adapting layout
reproduction: A title needs the exact model name plus a quantified hook and exceeds the default two-line rail.
impact: Copy repair could remove the subject to fit instead of preserving meaning.

title: YouTube output could contain silent or truncated audio
reproduction: A rendered collection item fails AAC, audio duration, or audible-audio validation.
impact: A video could look complete while losing the original speech after the opening minutes.

title: Tiny browser highlight aborted deterministic rendering
reproduction: A valid source target such as License: produces a yellow outline narrower than the readable-line gate.
impact: A valid content manifest failed rendering even though the page position itself was useful evidence.

title: Selected glossary definition was stored but invisible on X card
reproduction: The root X shot carries a glossary definition in audience_copy while the card renders only full_translation.
impact: The manifest passed readability checks but the viewer never saw the promised explanation.

title: YouTube interview highlight downloaded the complete source before selection
reproduction: Generate a 60–180 second known-tech interview highlight from a 15–120 minute YouTube source.
impact: The factory downloaded the entire source before transcript selection, wasting bandwidth, time, storage, and retry cost.

title: X acquisition hid OpenCLI exit diagnostics
reproduction: The same OpenCLI X command succeeds directly but exits 69 when the Video Factory subprocess lacks browser automation access.
impact: The job reported only CalledProcessError, so operators could not distinguish a browser permission boundary from a bad URL or missing post.

title: Editorial agent stopped after a cheap model exhausted semantic repairs
reproduction: The primary low-cost writer produces three near-duplicate retention hooks and the independent copy critic rejects every bounded repair.
impact: A valid source required Codex intervention even though a stronger qualified model was available through a configured fallback provider; an explicit primary-provider choice incorrectly disabled that route.

title: LLM retry multiplication allowed one logical call to block for six minutes
reproduction: A provider returns empty or invalid content while each of three transport attempts waits for the former 120-second timeout.
impact: A 12-call primary plus 14-call fallback path could take many minutes without local CPU work or visible progress.

title: Temporal wording still implied an explicitly unproven causal link
reproduction: Evidence says an account was suspended after a configuration change and the author explicitly says they do not know whether the setup triggered it.
impact: Short-video copy such as '照做后被封' was likely to be read as causation even after replacing the stronger word '导致'.

title: Employee reply was promoted to an official company response
reproduction: A company employee replies from a personal X account inside a public discussion thread.
impact: Viewer-facing copy called the personal comment the company's first official response, overstating source identity and authority.

title: WeChat playback chrome covered the fixed title and conclusion rails
reproduction: View a 1080x1920 information-frame video full-screen in WeChat Channels on a phone with status chrome and the post-title/action overlay visible.
impact: The first title line overflowed beneath the top status area and the fixed conclusion collided with the WeChat post title, making essential copy unreadable.

title: WeChat publisher silently left the original-content declaration unchecked
reproduction: Submit a Tencent/WeChat Channels video through the pinned social-auto-upload runtime and inspect the original-content checkbox before the final publish click.
impact: The publisher reported success without applying the creator's required original-content declaration.

title: Expired WeChat cookie was misclassified as an uncertain submission
reproduction: Let Tencent upload-video reject an expired cookie before constructing the uploader after a stale preflight check reported valid.
impact: A definitely safe pre-submit failure became non-retryable, forcing manual batch repair and delaying publication.

title: One WeChat publish attempt opened the creator page four times
reproduction: Run an approved Tencent publish batch and count browser launches from batch preflight, CLI setup, uploader validation, and the real upload page.
impact: Redundant login probes slowed every publish, confused the operator, and repeatedly rotated the WeChat session cookie.

title: Normal video mastering ran a redundant MoneyPrinterTurbo render before FFmpeg
reproduction: Render an editorial or GitHub video and inspect the mastering path after the native visual track is complete.
impact: Every job paid for an unnecessary external Python render and inherited its task-directory, placeholder-timing, and subprocess failure modes even though FFmpeg rebuilt the final output from the original native visual.

title: Capture stopped when optional web-scroll-video patch markers changed
reproduction: Format or upgrade the pinned web-scroll-video runner so one exact source marker used by the padded-runner patch no longer matches.
impact: A cosmetic integration patch became a single point of failure and required Codex to repair the dependency adapter before any video could be produced.

title: Default Chinese font resolved to one developer's MoneyPrinterTurbo checkout
reproduction: Run composition outside /Users/clairehou/pyProjects without setting VIDEO_FACTORY_FONT.
impact: Rendering failed on otherwise valid macOS, Linux, Windows, CI, or container installations even when a Chinese-capable system font was available.

title: Equal shot timing ignored visible text density
reproduction: Generate a BGM-only story whose evidence shots all receive the same duration even though one screen contains several times more visible Chinese and technical text than another.
impact: Dense evidence disappeared before viewers could finish reading it, while sparse shots consumed the same amount of the fixed runtime. The persistent upper hook and lower conclusion are intentional and remain pinned.

title: Experimental Radar styling silently replaced the stable compositor
reproduction: Load an archived manifest after adding expanded layouts, glass glosses, crop zoom, badges, and camera motion directly to the default render path.
impact: Every existing video changed at once, making regressions indistinguishable from intentional redesign and removing the known-good rollback path.

title: Radar effects had no bounded render fallback
reproduction: A platform FFmpeg build rejects the focus-crop or animated transition filter graph.
impact: A cosmetic enhancement could abort the entire agent instead of returning a readable stable video and recording the degraded path.

title: Retention prompt forced conflict when a direct fact was the better opening
reproduction: Generate a short for a strong technical announcement whose evidence contains no honest incumbent conflict or surprising comparison.
impact: The writer could manufacture drama, competitor framing, or ROI instead of quickly reporting what happened.

title: Radar density routing crashed on the first real capture
reproduction: Frame an archived OpenRouter capture with radar_v2 so the compositor classifies a highlighted price-table shot.
impact: The renderer raised NameError before FFmpeg because density matching depended on an unimported regular-expression module.

title: Radar identifier badge covered the first evidence lines
reproduction: Inspect the first OpenRouter Radar frame with a category pill and long model identifier at the top of the evidence pane.
impact: The badge overlapped the page headline and price proof, reducing readability while trying to add navigation metadata.

title: Hugging Face thumbnail URL became a fake model identifier
reproduction: Render a model story whose archived image URL under /social-thumbnails/models appears before the actual Hugging Face repository URL.
impact: The on-screen direct badge displayed HF: social-thumbnails/models instead of the real owner/model path.

title: Empty Radar metadata rail reduced evidence height
reproduction: Render a tweet story such as Jeff Dean or Sam Altman with no package, repository, model identifier, or factual category label.
impact: The compositor still reserved 88 pixels and drew a link-only badge, adding noise while shrinking the real evidence pane.

title: External visual critic retried failing media payloads without a bounded fallback ladder
reproduction: Send four videos to an AI Studio app, retry the same internal error, split to two videos, then encounter a paid-key requirement in the multimodal playground.
impact: A production agent could loop on a broken session, repeatedly upload the same assets, or implicitly cross a billing boundary instead of degrading safely and asking for authorization.

title: Developer artifact extraction discarded type and provenance
reproduction: Extract a package, model, container, or repository identifier for the Radar metadata rail and receive only a presentation string.
impact: Adding new ecosystems required more display-oriented regex patches, while downstream validation could not distinguish artifact kind or trace the source used for the badge.

title: Radar generation silently reused a classic-profile content cache
reproduction: Generate a URL with the classic profile, then request the same URL with --render-profile radar_v2 without --refresh.
impact: The factory reported a successful Radar request while returning the old classic manifest and copy contract, so visual A/B results were not actually generated by Radar V2.

title: Mechanical Radar contract errors consumed repeated LLM repair calls
reproduction: Return an otherwise grounded Radar brief with an unsupported label, over-budget visible copy, an invalid narrative beat, or a selected hook outside the candidate list.
impact: The agent repeatedly called writer and fallback models for deterministic formatting defects, increasing latency and cost while still failing to produce a manifest.

title: Radar validators disagreed on complete root-tweet translation length
reproduction: Generate a Radar X story whose complete first-post translation is valid under the 40–120 character root-card rule but exceeds the 40-character evidence-chip limit.
impact: Both primary and fallback writers were rejected for a translation that another contract explicitly required, making successful X generation impossible for substantive posts.

title: Web opening inherited the complete-tweet translation budget
reproduction: Generate an OpenRouter Radar story whose first browser shot contains a translation longer than 40 equivalents.
impact: The canonicalizer retained up to 120 equivalents as if the browser shot were a complete root tweet, while validation rejected it and exhausted both primary and fallback writers.

title: Subject-free Radar hooks incorrectly received the extended headline budget
reproduction: Generate a Radar hook longer than 20 equivalents that does not preserve any exact subject name.
impact: Canonicalization kept the hook under the 28-equivalent exception while validation correctly allowed that exception only for an exact model, project, or actor name, triggering an unnecessary fallback model.

title: Trailing punctuation in a model numeric field aborted the whole repair
reproduction: Receive a duration-like JSON string such as '0.605.' from a model repair response.
impact: A harmless sentence-ending period caused float conversion to fail after several successful calls, discarding the entire grounded draft and starting an expensive fallback model.

title: OpenRouter discount monitor was routed as a 50-second benchmark deep dive
reproduction: Route https://openrouter.ai/models?discount=true after the page text mentions benchmarks and evaluations.
impact: A price/news Radar request became a 25–50 second deep dive with the wrong single-header layout instead of a ten-second pinned-rail flash.

title: Copy critic re-reviewed the entire script when only a few fields were missing
reproduction: Have the critic omit several translation fields from an otherwise complete review, then repeat the same full review request.
impact: The second call was slower, could omit the same fields again, and forced a grounded Radar draft into the expensive fallback writer instead of completing the missing checks.

title: Radar width canonicalization severed a conclusion mid-claim
reproduction: Return a fixed conclusion longer than 40 equivalents whose width boundary falls inside a final named item such as Boris Cherny.
impact: The persistent takeaway rail displayed an incomplete name and could claim that there were three facts while showing only two, reducing both readability and factual integrity.

title: Audience glossary injection could overflow a canonical Radar shot
reproduction: Canonicalize a 40-equivalent Radar fact, then inject the required plain-language definition of refusal rate.
impact: A deterministic readability enhancement made the same shot fail the deterministic screen budget and triggered repeated semantic repair calls.

title: Radar hook required an entire delivery-suffixed model artifact name
reproduction: Use a model subject such as GLM-5.3-Flash-Uncensored-FP8 while the mobile hook names the exact base model GLM-5.3-Flash.
impact: The validator rejected a factual, readable title because the full artifact suffix could not fit the mobile headline budget.

title: A context event could be both required and discarded
reproduction: Receive a context graph that places the same event ID in required_context_ids and discarded_context_ids.
impact: Canonicalization selected the required event while validation simultaneously treated it as leaked discarded research, making the brief impossible to satisfy.

title: Readable Flash timing was rejected for exceeding an aspirational ten-second target
reproduction: Generate a complete three-shot Flash whose balanced evidence holds need 11.6 seconds against a 10-second target.
impact: The factory discarded a valid concise story and invoked a rate-limited fallback model instead of honoring the product rule to hold denser screens slightly longer.

title: Copy critic shorthand paths looked like omitted translation reviews
reproduction: Have the semantic critic return evidence_shots[0].translation instead of the requested editorial_brief.evidence_shots[0].translation path.
impact: All translation checks were present but discarded as unknown aliases, so the agent repeated the review and then abandoned both primary and fallback drafts.

title: Generation cache validated migrations but copied stale JSON into the job
reproduction: Load a cached manifest that is normalized by the current serializer, pass validation, and then create a new job from that cache hit.
impact: The in-memory fixed conclusion passed validation while the new job still received the old truncated conclusion from disk.

title: Direct-fact openings were forced to manufacture a conflict
reproduction: Return a grounded Radar brief with opening_mode=direct_fact and an intentionally empty attention_strategy.conflict.
impact: The validator contradicted the adaptive opening contract and sent a complete factual update into semantic repair solely to invent tension.

title: Multi-model price monitor was forced into a single-model headline
reproduction: Generate the OpenRouter discount index while its brief contains several model subjects and the hook correctly describes the cross-provider price page.
impact: The generic model validator selected one batch model as the mandatory subject and rejected the more accurate price-monitor story angle.

title: Copy critic shot-ID field paths were discarded as unknown
reproduction: Have the critic return shot-1.translation rather than editorial_brief.evidence_shots[0].translation.
impact: Valid per-shot semantic reviews were treated as omissions, causing a redundant supplemental review and eventual fallback failure.

title: Writer and critic shared the same model-level editorial blind spot
reproduction: Use the same model configuration to generate a story and approve its story axis, wording, and visual hierarchy.
impact: A fluent but weak directing choice could pass because the reviewer reproduced the writer's assumptions instead of challenging them.

title: Radar screen budget rendered optional copy as sentence fragments
reproduction: Place a near-40-equivalent fact above an optional audience line such as 'OpenRouter 模型库可直接筛选折扣线路'.
impact: The canonicalizer filled the few remaining equivalents with fragments such as 'OpenRouter 模' or '单价降至每秒', making the finished frame look broken.

title: UI rerender silently re-authored an approved story
reproduction: Rerender an approved manifest with a new compositor while rerender still calls canonicalize_editorial_brief.
impact: A visual-only change could replace the hook, conclusion, evidence copy, or shot order and make a better-looking video tell a different story.

title: High-attention hook optimization abandoned the selected story axis
reproduction: Start with a people-change angle about Jeff Dean and three Google collaborators, then let the critic demand a hook different from the descriptive headline.
impact: The hook, conclusion, and final payoff pivoted from the Google team move to Discovery Loop's secondary parallel-experiment capability.

title: Direct OpenRouter discount-page generation bypassed the high-discount selection gate
reproduction: Generate the OpenRouter discount index directly while the most prominent current promotion is only 15% off.
impact: A routine promotion became a finished news video even though the product only wants exceptional price anomalies such as the verified 85.8% same-model saving.

title: Causal-safety copy replaced the bridge in a multi-party reply chain
reproduction: Tell the Sam Altman/Tibo account-suspension thread in three shots and omit Tibo's intervening reply while using a screenshot-proof disclaimer as the conclusion.
impact: Viewers saw Sam praise Tibo, an account suspension, and an Anthropic hiring reply without the response that explains why those events belong in one story.

title: Radar headline width clipping produced an unfinished hook
reproduction: Clip a hook such as '用户照 Tibo 的配置把 Claude Code 接到 GPT-5.6 Sol 后账号被停用' at the mobile width boundary.
impact: The permanent top rail ended at '接到', so the most important sentence looked broken even though the writer had supplied a complete shorter headline.

title: Both writer tiers exhausted repairs while omitting one reply-chain actor
reproduction: Ask the primary and fallback writers to preserve alex, Tibo, Boris, and Sam in one short event chain; each repair continues to omit Tibo or Boris.
impact: The agent correctly refused an unclear story but still required Codex intervention instead of recovering from its own structured subjects and evidence links.

title: Event-chain fallback dropped required context labels while preserving their evidence
reproduction: Rebuild a multi-party chain from subjects after context research marked the quoted setup and appeal posts as required.
impact: The facts remained visible, but exact causal setup validation rejected the fallback because context_event_ids were not migrated with overlapping evidence.

title: Copy critic demanded the same harness glossary in every visible field
reproduction: Use the specialist term harness in a hook, conclusion, and evidence translation after the first relevant shot can carry one adjacent definition.
impact: Repeated glossary demands overflowed mobile rails and exhausted both writer tiers even though one explanation was sufficient for comprehension.

title: Optional invented direct identifier exhausted an otherwise valid story
reproduction: Return a strong grounded brief plus a direct_identifier that cannot be found verbatim in archived evidence.
impact: An optional metadata badge consumed semantic repair rounds and blocked the entire video instead of safely disappearing.

title: Manifest loading rewrote story before a UI-only rerender
reproduction: Load an approved Radar manifest for rerender after disabling canonicalization only in the scene recompilation method.
impact: The loader still clipped an approved Sam event-chain fact to an unfinished phrase before the visual renderer received it.

title: Person-first hook assumed a technical figure was already famous
reproduction: Lead a Jeff Dean departure story with 'Jeff Dean announced' even though Google is the more recognizable audience anchor.
impact: The hook read like a neutral bulletin and gave mainland viewers no immediate reason to care.

title: Discount video treated low price as sufficient production guidance
reproduction: Describe a 90% OpenRouter discount without the model workload or route-specific uptime and response-time question.
impact: Developers learned the price but not whether the route fit their work or could safely serve production traffic.

title: Company conflict was diluted into a sequence of personal replies
reproduction: Tell the Sam/Tibo/Boris thread without naming OpenAI and Anthropic in the hook.
impact: The strongest reason to stop scrolling—the public tension between two AI vendors—disappeared.

title: Original-post Chinese translation was unreadably small on mobile
reproduction: Render a root X-card translation at 21–27px on a 1384px intermediate card and then scale it down into a 1080px WeChat frame.
impact: The most important Chinese explanation was technically present but not comfortably readable on a phone.

title: A fixed 40-character screen budget removed useful context instead of adding reading time
reproduction: Apply the same 40-equivalent limit to every two-to-four-second evidence shot regardless of typography and duration.
impact: The system produced sparse but shallow cards while other readable videos kept larger type and simply held denser screens longer.

title: Category pills displaced useful date context in time-sensitive flash videos
reproduction: Render a current X/news Flash with a large generic category capsule and a second link-hint capsule in the metadata rail.
impact: The interface looked templated while viewers could not see when the news happened.

title: A concrete earlier Google departure was rewritten as an abstract talent-war summary
reproduction: Use the Axios headline 'Google takes the hit in AI's talent war' as a visible pattern beat without opening the sourced event details.
impact: Viewers heard that Google was under pressure but never learned who left, where they went, or why the current four-person startup was part of a sequence.

title: Web capture could hold the pipeline lock indefinitely
reproduction: Let the Node recorder or one of its Chrome/FFmpeg children stop making progress during an evidence capture.
impact: The pipeline remained running for hours, held the scheduler lock, and prevented later discovery cycles from completing.

title: A source-image label caused HTML to be opened as image bytes
reproduction: Return visual_family=source_image while citing only a web page and an agent primary-source HTML archive.
impact: The material compiler trusted the label, Pillow opened a .source HTML document, and every deterministic rerender failed identically.

title: Every robotics feed failing was reported as an empty news cycle
reproduction: Run robotics discovery while DNS or network policy blocks every configured RSS and Google News endpoint.
impact: The audit said no_selection with zero candidates instead of reporting a search failure, so the agent could not activate a network fallback.

title: One busy robotics publication consumed the cross-source probe budget
reproduction: Pool hundreds of rows from several feeds, sort them only by timestamp, and probe the first ten globally.
impact: Ordinary articles from a frequent publisher displaced surprising demos and autonomous-driving events from other sources.

title: A 24-hour robotics window discarded still-current visual breakthroughs
reproduction: Restart after a weekend or blocked local run and discover a three-day-old first-ever robotics event with original video.
impact: The first 11-vs-11 humanoid RoboCup match was found but rejected before generation even though it was timely, visual, and surprising.

title: Simulation-only robotics claims scored like verified physical results
reproduction: Publish a long article with numeric 2D simulation results and explicitly state that no physical robot has verified them.
impact: An unverified theory received a top robotics score, blocked the channel, and displaced concrete demos and deployments.

title: Robotics discovery waited for every network source serially
reproduction: Fetch ten feeds and then ten candidate pages one at a time with a 45-second timeout per request.
impact: A healthy discovery-only pass could appear frozen for several minutes before generation even started.

title: Structural validation referenced an undefined evidence map
reproduction: Validate a generated web story after adding verified source-image checks to validate_editorial_structure.
impact: Every newly selected robotics story failed before a manifest could be saved with NameError: evidence_items_by_id is not defined.

title: The agent retried an identical internal programming error three times
reproduction: Raise NameError before a manifest exists during discovery adoption.
impact: The fallback loop repeated the same impossible attempt instead of stopping immediately and preserving the candidate for a corrected runtime.

title: Generation changed the subject inside a multi-video robotics roundup
reproduction: Select IEEE Spectrum's Microduck item, then give the writer the complete Video Friday page containing many unrelated robot videos without the discovery scope.
impact: The director replaced Microduck with a later pharmacy robot, so the generated story no longer matched the candidate that won discovery.

title: Roundup browser capture showed a different robot than the Chinese claim
reproduction: Scroll a long lazy-loaded IEEE Video Friday page to Microduck text after multiple embedded videos change page height.
impact: The Chinese overlay described Microduck while the recorded page visibly showed EmoLo and other unrelated robots, despite automated checks passing.

title: Routing a news event to its official page dropped the date-fast-news label
reproduction: Discover a dated IEEE roundup item, then generate from the subject-specific official product page whose HTML has no machine-readable publication date.
impact: The safer official visual lost the small date + 快报 context required for time-sensitive news.

title: Automatic discovery silently rendered the legacy classic profile
reproduction: Adopt a selected discovery candidate without explicitly setting GenerateOptions.render_profile.
impact: New robotics and autonomous-driving videos bypassed the current Radar UI, including its small date + 快报 metadata rail.

title: One code proof collapsed an ordinary Flash into a tiny deep-content header
reproduction: Generate a product/news Flash whose final evidence family is code while the overall topic is neither a repository, paper, nor architecture walkthrough.
impact: The footer disappeared and a long news hook was forced into one very small line, even though the story needed the normal large pinned news header.

title: The Flash contract forced BGM-only evidence screens to change after 2.8 seconds
reproduction: Render three dense source screens containing Chinese evidence copy under the former 1.3–2.8 second Flash cadence.
impact: Viewers could neither watch the original motion nor finish reading the visible Chinese before the next cut.

title: The date-fast-news rail preferred capture day over publication day
reproduction: Route a dated discovery event to an official page captured several days later, with both evidence records sharing the same URL.
impact: The video displayed 08-31 快报 for an item actually published on 08-28.

title: A robotics roundup entered discovery as one headline instead of independent events
reproduction: Discover a Video Friday page containing separate household, toy, pharmacy, and industrial robot videos with their own primary links.
impact: Only the robot named in the parent headline competed; useful household and worker robots inside the same source were invisible to ranking.

title: A visually catchy toy robot outranked a useful worker robot
reproduction: Compare an eligible desk-sized research toy with an eligible physical robot completing laundry or household work.
impact: Cheap price and video keywords outweighed real-world labor value, producing a less consequential story for the target audience.

title: Robotics and autonomous-driving events competed for one generation slot
reproduction: Find one high-value household robot and one high-value public-road robotaxi event in the same discovery cycle.
impact: One audience-relevant category displaced the other even though the product requires at most one result from each category.

title: An official product video was replaced by rapid jumps across its web page
reproduction: Generate a three-shot robotics Flash when the selected event supplies both an official source video and an official product page.
impact: The edit switched between DOM regions too quickly instead of letting viewers watch one complete defining action.

title: A plain YouTube 403 stopped official-footage acquisition
reproduction: Download an official YouTube video when the system yt-dlp client receives HTTP 403 but the managed mweb PO-token runtime is healthy.
impact: The agent lost the strongest source visual instead of switching to its already-installed acquisition fallback.

title: The motion fallback selected foreground hand movement instead of robot action
reproduction: Rank five-second windows in a robot demo where a large hand moves near the frame edge before the robot completes a useful action in the center.
impact: When the vision selector was unavailable, the fallback chose the busiest pixels rather than the clearest subject action.

title: Official source footage was squeezed inside a portrait evidence track
reproduction: Render a landscape official robot clip inside the Flash middle pane after concatenating it with portrait information cards.
impact: The footage was technically present but appeared as a small strip, making viewers think the middle section was not the original video.

title: Atomized roundup events with official videos failed the visual gate
reproduction: Split a robotics weekly roundup into subject events whose local paragraphs are concise and whose metadata includes an official YouTube video.
impact: Deployed industrial, laundry, and pharmacy robots were rejected as missing a visual path while a long text-only article won the generation slot.

title: Generic prose made a robot social study look like a useful physical task
reproduction: Score a Pepper interaction study containing generic phrases such as 'people move' and 'more autonomous' plus references to homes and hospitals.
impact: Substring matching promoted a social-science article to the same impact tier as robots that visibly perform daily work.

title: Every official source clip was forced to exactly five seconds
reproduction: Compare an instant single jump with a multi-step industrial manipulation that needs setup, action, and payoff.
impact: The fixed duration either rushed meaningful robot work or held trivial motion longer than necessary.

title: Source-video rerender redownloaded an asset already archived in the workspace
reproduction: Rerender a generated motion-first story with the same official YouTube URL and an existing captured_asset in its manifest.
impact: A deterministic timing adjustment repeated the slow 403-to-managed-download path and wasted network work.

title: Reselected source-video timestamps did not replace stale evidence metadata
reproduction: Reselect a seven-second clip using the same stable source-video evidence ID as an older five-second selection.
impact: The schedule could claim a longer action while the renderer still read and played the old five-second timestamps.

title: Reusing an archived source video attempted to archive-copy the file onto itself
reproduction: Resolve a source-video URL to an existing workspace asset and pass that same absolute path back through archive_asset.
impact: The optimized reuse path raised SameFileError and silently fell back to the older clip selection.

title: Radar hook preserved a model-written named entity fragment
reproduction: Supply a hook ending with the severed phrase '交付给财富全' alongside complete alternative hooks.
impact: The pinned headline looked visibly broken even though the story and evidence were otherwise correct.

title: Pinned headlines were visually centered inside an oversized minimum rail
reproduction: Render both a short one-line Radar headline and a long multi-line headline in the shared upper rail.
impact: Short titles floated in excess empty space and line starts moved horizontally; reducing the rail naively would have hidden long titles.

title: Long highlighted Chinese translation was truncated with an ellipsis
reproduction: Render the Waymo Munich source paragraph translation in the middle evidence chip at a fixed 40px font and three-line limit.
impact: The card removed the end of the primary evidence claim, so viewers could not read the complete translated source.

title: Translation-card lines were individually centered
reproduction: Render a three-line Chinese evidence translation whose lines have visibly different lengths.
impact: Each line began at a different horizontal position, making a dense BGM-only translation slower to scan.

title: Runtime problems were logged repeatedly but never entered a bounded improvement loop
reproduction: Let the ten-minute scheduler encounter the same authentication, generation, or rendering failure several times.
impact: The audit log accumulated duplicate rows while no asynchronous agent clustered, reproduced, backed off, or prepared a verified fix.

title: A reviewed manifest and rendered video were not bound to immutable run hashes
reproduction: Change or replace a job manifest or final MP4 after result.json was written.
impact: A later audit could inspect different content from what the viewer saw and attempt to fix the wrong generation behavior.

title: Adding remote observability could have made production depend on the collector
reproduction: Run generation with Phoenix disabled, its Python packages absent, the collector offline, or the local event spool unwritable.
impact: Tracing failures could otherwise interrupt the video pipeline that they were intended to diagnose.

title: Shadow audit discarded the model's proposed fix after recording only its verdict
reproduction: Run a shadow audit that returns a policy or code candidate and inspect latest-run.json.
impact: The audit showed that a candidate passed verification but did not preserve the exact proposal needed for later review, calibration, or promotion.

title: Grounded field-level copy review approved the wrong overall story
reproduction: Give the critic a factually grounded people-move cut that spends most of its runtime on the startup mechanism rather than the incumbent's talent loss.
impact: The generated video could pass every wording check while flattening the selected event, company conflict, evidence hierarchy, and audience payoff.

title: Discovery heartbeat hid a source/query recall gap for AI hardware news
reproduction: Run the ten-minute scheduler after The Information reported OpenAI buying Macs and Anthropic renting Mac mini capacity through AWS.
impact: The news channel woke normally but its narrow queries, trusted-domain list, missing hardware feed, and 12-hour window prevented the event from ever reaching scoring; the saved run did not explain the first failing gate.

title: X-attached explanatory GIF was dropped from the generated video
reproduction: Generate a technical X post whose structured capture exposes an animated GIF as a video.twimg.com MP4.
impact: The writer received only post text, so the final cut replaced the author's explanatory motion graphic with static paraphrase cards.

title: Unicode math subscripts rendered as missing-glyph boxes
reproduction: Render Q₁₀, K₁, or QKᵀ with the bundled Noto Sans CJK font.
impact: Correct source notation became visibly corrupted in the final phone video.

title: Grounded videos could remain source paraphrases with no editorial extension

title: Static Radar timing could expand toward 30 seconds like motion-led stories
reproduction: Canonicalize a static three- or four-card Radar story with dense text and let readability timing extend every hold.

title: Disabled MacRumors source could re-enter through a forum/feed configuration
reproduction: Configure an old MacRumors RSS/forum source after the publication was removed from the editorial source list.

title: Model selected source_image when acquisition archived no renderable image
reproduction: Generate a robotics or paper shot with visual_family=source_image but cite only text/visual-analysis evidence without a captured image asset.

reproduction: Validate a source result written as 61.0% when the Chinese hook naturally renders the same value as 61%.

reproduction: Attach a project README that says credentials are read from environment variables and never written to files.

reproduction: Validate an OpenRouter workload sentence ending with '$0.019800.'.

reproduction: Add All-In, Sequoia, a16z, Lightspeed, MAD Podcast, and SaaStr as query pools, then run the 30-day discovery window.

title: Fixed YouTube metadata budget starved later discovery pools
reproduction: Configure 13 YouTube pools while metadata_probe_limit remains 10.
impact: The final startup, robotics, and autonomous-driving pools received no metadata inspection and could never become eligible.

title: One broad substring awarded full YouTube audience relevance
reproduction: Score text containing a generic word such as team or a word containing the letters ai, without a concrete technical topic or consequence.
impact: Unrelated or generic discussions received the same 25 audience points as specific developer, hardware, robotics, and autonomy stories.

title: Long YouTube interview transcript exhausted editorial-planning output
reproduction: Send a 70K–98K character interview transcript and unrestricted terminology request to the translation planner.
impact: The selected OpenRouter model returned empty content with finish_reason=length, and semantic repair repeated the same oversized prompt.

title: Curated interview failed when the model omitted speaker_label
reproduction: Plan an a16z interview whose description names David George and Gavin Baker but whose model response omits speaker_label.
impact: A fully grounded highlight was rejected because fallback identity logic recognized only globally preconfigured people.

title: OpenRouter rate limit required manual generation restart
reproduction: Return HTTP 429 for all bounded OpenRouter attempts during YouTube planning.
impact: The factory stopped after two short retries and repeated the same delay for later calls instead of switching providers.

title: Malformed terminology rows and repeated first-use explanations blocked SaaStr generation
reproduction: Return bilingual_once without an explanation, translate without a target, or repeat a bilingual explanation in multiple subtitle cues.
impact: The agent detected the glossary error but could not normalize it, so the translated clip never reached rendering.

title: Interview boundary caption and cached bounded clip were handled as full source
reproduction: Select a clip ending 0.08 seconds after the next caption starts, then rebuild from a previously downloaded bounded clip.
impact: A nearly out-of-range caption failed reading speed, and local reuse could shift the clip timeline or trigger another blocked download.

title: Bounded YouTube media download re-encoded and incomplete audio shortened final output
reproduction: Download a 184-second 1080p section with forced keyframes, or render a stream-copy clip whose audio CDN response ends several seconds early.
impact: The acquisition ran below realtime and a later render had 176.21 seconds of audio for a 180-second video.

title: YouTube headline and cold-open evidence were selected independently
reproduction: Pair the hook 'AI不是零和：开源、云、应用都能赢' with the highest generic source window 'Here is Fable 5.1', or accept 'SAS 末日论' in a SaaS market story.
impact: The title promised one claim while the first source footage proved another, and a visible acronym typo weakened trust despite all structural checks passing.

title: Interview header repeated the problem but omitted its trigger and the speaker's answer
reproduction: Render a no-footer interview with a short hook only, or load a human-edited translation plan whose terminology no longer matches its original glossary.
impact: Unused vertical space did not help comprehension, the causal chain was incomplete, and cached editorial improvements could render before a terminology mismatch was reported.

title: Dashboard repeated an expired WeChat preflight and offered no login or interview-rights recovery
reproduction: Click publish with an expired Tencent cookie, or enqueue a YouTube interview whose only failed check is rights_review.
impact: The retry repeated the same invalid-cookie check, terminal escapes leaked into the UI, and interview videos remained permanently blocked with no auditable human-review action.

title: Cached YouTube asset reuse copied a content-addressed file onto itself
reproduction: Regenerate from a subtitle path already inside workspace/assets/youtube-subtitles.
impact: The otherwise recoverable rerun crashed with shutil.SameFileError and required a manual path workaround.

title: Interview repair silently center-clamped long selections and accepted dangling cold-open fragments
reproduction: Return a 200-second interview range or a 7-second hook cue ending on a connector such as 'the'.
impact: A structurally valid 180-second clip could start or end mid-argument, while the first source caption visibly stopped before completing its claim.

title: Mixed Chinese-English interview title overflowed despite character-count wrapping
reproduction: Render the a16z hook 'AI不是零和：开源、云、应用都能赢' at a fixed 64px size.
impact: The final words crossed the right edge even though the title passed the character limit.

title: Speech fillers were translated as visible Chinese subtitle words
reproduction: Translate 'Um, open source wins, you know, inference cloud, uh.' as a bilingual subtitle.
impact: Chinese captions showed meaningless hesitation words and sounded mechanically translated.

title: WeChat subtitle cards stayed narrow and centered on a wide mobile viewport
reproduction: Render a bilingual interview caption in the 1080px WeChat profile.
impact: Both languages wrapped prematurely inside a small centered chip while useful horizontal space remained empty.

title: Direct source clips were marked original and short titles were cut mid-thought
reproduction: Publish a direct YouTube interview clip with the global originality patch and derive its short title by slicing the first 15 characters.
impact: The originality claim was unsafe and the public short title ended as an incomplete phrase.

title: Chinese interview title began its second line with list punctuation
reproduction: Fit 'AI不是零和：开源、云、应用都能赢' by pixel width while optimizing only for balanced line lengths.

title: Physical-technology stories could be selected without video and then became tiring text slides
reproduction: Select a robotics or autonomous-driving article with several images but no explicit source video, or give a valid source clip less time than two explanatory cards.

title: A published YouTube interview was regenerated under a second story angle
reproduction: Publish one clip from a YouTube source, reset or lose its generated-event state, then discover a different insight from the same source video.

title: Routine city expansions and supplier certificates passed the physical-tech video gate
reproduction: Provide a source video for an existing robotaxi service entering more cities, or for a supplier earning a quality-management certificate.

title: Startup cash and valuation stories scored as audience-relevant technology
reproduction: Discover a startup acquisition article dominated by sale price, cash balance, valuation, and shareholder terms but with no AI or technology consequence.

title: YouTube stage directions were translated as visible Chinese speech
reproduction: Translate a mixed cue such as 'Um [clears throat] and then...' and render a cached collection manifest.
impact: The subtitle displayed '[清喉咙]' as if it were part of the speaker's argument, making the translation look mechanically copied from accessibility captions.

reproduction: Generate the Empirik story with an opportunity that explicitly names DevOps/SRE outage pressure, then select a hook led by the $21M round and spinout status.

title: Long bilingual interview subtitles were forced into two clipped lines
reproduction: Render a long English interview cue and its Chinese translation in the 1080px WeChat subtitle card.

title: Interview subtitle cards rendered paragraph-sized bilingual cues without adaptive reflow
reproduction: Render a long aligned bilingual source thought inside a fixed-height, character-count-wrapped subtitle card.

reproduction: Regenerate an archived YouTube interview while the live yt-dlp subtitle request ends with an SSL EOF error.

reproduction: Translate a 3.04-second caption into more than 36 visible Chinese characters, then finish the expensive media render before checking the 12-character-per-second limit.

reproduction: Return an evidence-grounded but longer-than-24-character speaker_label while channel metadata has a concise valid identity.

title: Colon-biased headline wrapping left most of the first line empty

title: Editorial transport fallback silently weakened interview hooks
reproduction: Let the primary OpenRouter planning request end with finish_reason=length or IncompleteRead, then accept the native transport fallback's factual topic labels as final hooks.

title: Deterministic rerender rejected YouTube collection manifests

title: Cached YouTube cues still displayed dependent sentence fragments

title: Large merged-caption repair dropped cue ids in one oversized model response
reproduction: Send thirteen merged interview cues through one constrained JSON translation response and receive only a subset of the required ids.

title: Old terminology plans forced established Chinese technical terms back to English
reproduction: Load a cached plan that marks infrastructure, data centers, open-source, or application layer as preserve-English terminology.
impact: Natural repaired Chinese either failed the terminology gate or regressed into awkward English-heavy subtitles.

reproduction: Fit a long Chinese subtitle exactly to the card width so the final full stop overflows after the last glyph.
impact: The subtitle remained technically inside the card but displayed a lone punctuation mark on a fourth line.

title: Kinsoku-safe subtitle exceeded the card width at the normal minimum font
reproduction: Keep closing punctuation with its preceding glyph or render a long indivisible source token when the resulting line is a few pixels wider than the safe area at the normal minimum font size.
impact: The renderer correctly blocked instead of clipping, but deterministic rerender could not finish even though a small bounded font reduction would preserve every character legibly.

title: Semantic subtitle preservation overcorrected into paragraph-sized cards
reproduction: Render a fourteen-second interview cue containing several coordinated clauses after disabling all bilingual display splitting.
impact: The source and translation stayed aligned, but viewers had to read three or four lines at once instead of following the speaker clause by clause.

title: Translate terminology rows did not require Chinese output
reproduction: Mark chips and applications as translate entries while leaving those English words inside one or more cached Chinese subtitle cues.

title: Renderer repartitioned model-reviewed semantic caption cards
reproduction: Pass a reviewed -card- cue containing a complete when/that construction into the generic duration-based display splitter, which divides it again before the complement.

title: Global final style review rewrote already-good Chinese captions
reproduction: Run a final style pass over every interview caption even when no specific, auditable defect was detected.

title: Cached terminology repair aborted on a transient directing-provider failure
reproduction: Regenerate an interview from a cached translation plan while the directing model's terminology-repair request fails with a transient SSL EOF.
impact: The agent aborted before semantic caption review even though its normal translation writer and deterministic exact-term enforcement were both available.

title: Cached interview captions were semantically processed again
reproduction: Generate from a translation plan that already contains reviewed -card- cues and an interview_semantic_subtitle_cards trace.

title: Fidelity reviewer rewrote translations instead of auditing them
reproduction: Ask the independent reviewer to return replacement Chinese for every card after the translation pass.
impact: The review stage introduced literal wording and made model provenance impossible to interpret as a clean translation-versus-verdict separation.

title: Kimi coding-plan calls could be misrouted to metered APIs
reproduction: Request Kimi K3 using the display alias while only the generic Moonshot/OpenRouter paths and temperature 0.2 are supported.

title: Hook critic was also trusted as the subtitle fidelity reviewer
reproduction: Use the Gemini directing critic to approve Chinese subtitle fidelity after Kimi translation.
impact: Fluent but literal or semantically shifted Chinese passed because visual directing taste and bilingual fidelity were conflated.

title: A batch rejection exploded into one model call per subtitle card
reproduction: Reject a few rows in an otherwise valid translated subtitle batch and recover every card independently.
impact: A single interview could trigger roughly twenty extra translation calls, increasing cost and latency while discarding already approved captions.

title: Reviewer outage could silently publish unreviewed subtitle cards
reproduction: Configure an independent subtitle reviewer, then make its transport fail while the translation batch remains structurally valid.
impact: The agent treated deterministic length and terminology checks as a substitute for bilingual review and could publish naturalness or fidelity errors.

title: Trusted YouTube channels and sponsor copy admitted non-IT episodes

reproduction: Let article extraction fail and fall back to a large raw HTML page containing metadata, navigation, ads, and script text.

reproduction: Split immediately before 'and if' when the following ASR span repeats words and phrases, or end a card on the broken parenthetical word 'though'.
impact: The translator received fragments such as 'constraints constraints' without their governing predicate and produced unnatural Chinese that viewers could not understand on first read.

title: Long SQLite readers blocked every generation write
reproduction: Run a long dashboard or diagnostic SELECT against the workspace index while generation saves a candidate or collection manifest.
impact: Generation completed its model work but failed at persistence with 'database is locked', forcing an expensive manual rerun.

reproduction: Treat ordinary YouTube captions as equally unreliable and run speech recognition over the complete selected clip.
impact: Generation became unnecessarily slow and expensive even though only a few visibly corrupted ASR spans needed audio verification.

title: A cached local-caption timeline was rebased as full-video seconds
reproduction: Reuse a no-render translation plan whose cues were already clip-local while its historical source_clip metadata still said rebased=false.

reproduction: Rerun the same source clip after changing prompts, model routing, or subtitle segmentation and accept the newest structurally valid translation automatically.
impact: A concise accepted line such as '长期来看，行业利润会逐渐向应用层转移。' regressed into literal, awkward Chinese despite passing automated checks.

title: Audio verification created a meaningless standalone subtitle fragment
reproduction: Correct 'The compet cycle tends to be though' to the short fragment 'cycle tends to be' and translate it as an independent card.
impact: The viewer saw a weak sentence such as '这个周期往往如此。' before the real payoff, making the argument harder rather than easier to follow.

title: Headline optimization broke the fixed first-screen story package
reproduction: Rerun an accepted interview plan after a directing-policy change, rank headlines independently, and preserve or replace hook_context in a separate decision.
impact: The first screen combined a stronger-sounding title with an unrelated or shortened explanatory subtitle, so viewers could no longer grasp the full clip meaning.
